title: Elongated rectangular prism
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector of [0.0, 0.0, 0.0341]. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. Begin with the first loop, drawing the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.0682, 0.0), followed by the second line from (0.0682, 0.0) to (0.0682, 0.0043). Continue with the third line from (0.0682, 0.0043) to (0.0043, 0.0043), the fourth line from (0.0043, 0.0043) to (0.0043, 0.0682), the fifth line from (0.0043, 0.0682) to (0.0, 0.0682), and finally the sixth line back to the origin. Scale this two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.0682. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and translating it using the vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0341]. Extrude the transformed two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.7159 units to create a new solid body. The resulting vertical elongated rectangular prism has a length of 0.06818181818181816 units, a width of 0.06818181818181816 units, and a height of 0.7159090909090909 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0682, 0).lineTo(0.0682, 0.0043).lineTo(0.0043, 0.0043).lineTo(0.0043, 0.0682).lineTo(0, 0.0682).close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the rectangular prism
extruded = sketch.extrude(0.7159)

# Translate the extruded shape
translated = extruded.translate((0, 0, 0.0341))

# The final model
r = translated

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0682, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0682, 0.0045) \
     .lineTo(0.0045, 0.0045) \
     .lineTo(0.0045, 0.0682) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0682) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.7159)

# Translate the object
r = r.translate((0.0, 0.0, 0.0341))

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# L-angle profile dimensions
leg = 0.0682      # length of each leg
thk = 0.0045      # material thickness
h = 0.7159        # extrusion height (Z)

# Build the L-shaped profile in the XY plane and extrude along Z
profile = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(leg, 0)
    .lineTo(leg, thk)
    .lineTo(thk, thk)
    .lineTo(thk, leg)
    .lineTo(0, leg)
    .close()
)

r = profile.extrude(h)
